overall_conclusion: No route is promoted by the policy change alone. Routes previously penalized mainly for small absolute profit or capacity are retained/reclassified as WATCH or low-priority research-eligible. Structural/method failures remain negative until the decisive dependency changes. WATCH is now the durable mechanism for later news/regime-driven resurrection.
